coverage.headline: IEEPA Tariff Refund: Key FAQs for Importers
coverage.summary: BDO's updated FAQ reports that class certification motions in Freestyle World and V.O.S. Selections — directly bearing on whether finally liquidated entries can access IEEPA refunds outside CAPE — have drawn DOJ opposition briefs, with CIT oral arguments scheduled for August 2026 and a ruling expected shortly thereafter, though further Federal Circuit appeal is anticipated.

coverage.headline: US Moves for Burlap and Barrel to Be 'Master Case' in Litigation Against Section 301 Tariffs
coverage.summary: The U.S. government filed an August 4 motion at the Court of International Trade asking that Burlap and Barrel v. United States (CIT # 26-03345) be designated the 'master case' for coordinated briefing and oral argument across three parallel challenges to the administration's new Section 301 forced-labor tariffs, with plaintiffs' motions for judgment proposed due August 14 and the government's consolidated response due September 15.
